profile.summary: Anthropic is a San Francisco-based AI safety company founded in 2021 by Dario Amodei, Daniela Amodei, and other former OpenAI researchers, best known for its Claude family of large language models. The company has rapidly scaled its enterprise business, landing landmark deployments with Deloitte (470k users) and Cognizant (350k users), and reported approximately $4.6B in revenue for full-year 2025. Backed by Amazon, Google, and Lightspeed at a $61.5B+ valuation, Anthropic is widely viewed as one of the most consequential AI companies globally, with an IPO trajectory being closely watched by the market.

profile.summary: Vercel is a San Francisco-based cloud platform (founded 2015 as ZEIT) that enables developers to build, deploy, and scale web applications — best known for creating and maintaining the Next.js framework and, more recently, the AI code-generation tool v0. The company has executed a sharp pivot toward an "AI Cloud" strategy in 2025, with 30% of its platform apps now AI-generated and ARR doubling to $200M+ in 15 months. Following a heavily oversubscribed $300M Series F in September 2025 at a $9.3B valuation (backed by Accel, GIC, and BlackRock), Vercel is widely seen as a strong IPO candidate with SaaS-quality margins and elite AI-native enterprise customers.

profile.summary: Shopify is the world's leading cloud-based commerce platform, enabling merchants of all sizes to sell online and in-person across multiple channels globally. The company generated $11.6 billion in revenue and facilitated $378.4 billion in GMV in FY2025, achieving sustained profitability with $1.23 billion in net income. Shopify is aggressively pivoting to an AI-first operational model while expanding into enterprise B2B commerce and international markets, making it both a formidable platform incumbent and an active strategic acquirer.

profile.summary: Datadog is a publicly traded (NASDAQ: DDOG) AI-powered observability and security platform founded in 2010 by Olivier Pomel and Alexis Lê-Quôc, headquartered in New York City. The company generates ~$3.4B+ in annual SaaS revenue through a usage- and subscription-based model serving cloud-native enterprises across infrastructure monitoring, APM, log management, cloud security, and rapidly expanding AI observability. With accelerating top-line growth (~28% YoY in Q2 2025), a ~$95B market cap, strong free cash flow, and an aggressive AI product roadmap, Datadog is both a compelling growth story and an active strategic consolidator in the cloud-native tooling ecosystem.
